title: Re: Strike at Storeroom 4A
description: Re: Strike at Storeroom 4A — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Wally Wanka

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Destroy 12 Candy Fabricators in Storeroom 4A and return to Wally Wanka in The Embercore Portal.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Wally Wanka

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Embercore Path

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Destroy 12 Candy Fabricators in Storeroom 4A and return to Wally Wanka in The Embercore Portal.

Offer:

Storeroom 4A is a major victory for us, but even as we speak those twisted Abba Labbas are repairing the Candy Fabricators in an attempt to get back to full operational capacity. This wouldn't only set us back, but it would send a message to the rest of the Abba Labbas that they can fix the Candy Fabricators as fast as you destroy them. I don't know about you, but I would take offense to that! You should too! Your primary job is to demolish things and what would your contemporaries think of you if some knee high-lackey monster was outperforming you?!

Get down to Storeroom 4A as soon as you can and put the clamps on those Gosh-forsaken creatures before they repair all of the Candy Fabricators you so caringly and lovingly destroyed. When you have fixed the problem return to me, Wally Wanka, here in The Embercore Portal and I will pay you for your help.

Turn-in:

So, you ruined the day for those creepy Abba Labbas. Well done! Let me know if you would like to try this again.

Objectives:

  • Candy Fabricators

Client level range: 44–100
